final_answer: According to special relativity, nothing can travel faster than the speed of light because of the fundamental structure of spacetime. As an object with mass accelerates closer to the speed of light, its relativistic mass increases, requiring exponentially more energy to continue accelerating. This energy requirement approaches infinity as the speed of light is approached, making it impossible to reach or exceed it.
